answer: The protocol requires each AI agent to reserve a 1-unit capacity slot in a secure gateway, acting as an ivory tower for valid occupancy. An honest agent pays for its singular, exclusive reservation, while 1,000 fakes must incur immense, concurrent bandwidth costs to maintain these parallel slots, a burden that flows like a river against their thin margins. A verifier audits the layer of session heartbeats against a shale hard surface of records; any overlap triggers immediate, irreversible privilege revocation; no refunds exist to mitigate the loss.
